title: New crash lockups since 2.4.11

labels.name: Housekeeping:ToClose
labels.description: Issues reviewed and closed. Old requests, issues which are not bug, feature or documentation request

body:
Since upgrading to 2.4.11 I've been getting weird lockups where there are tons of IPV4 and IPV6 spoofing filling up the log file:
```
Oct  7 15:41:31 epc open5gs-upfd[78244]: #033[32m10/07 15:41:31.905#033[0m: [#033[33mupf#033[0m] #033[1;33mERROR#033[0m: Invalid packet [IP version:6, Packet Length:76] (../src/upf/gtp-path.c:533)
Oct  7 15:41:31 epc open5gs-upfd[78244]: 0000: 60000000 00240001 fe800000 00000000   `....$..........
Oct  7 15:41:31 epc open5gs-upfd[78244]: 0010: 4abf74ff fe09d010 ff020000 00000000   J.t.............
Oct  7 15:41:31 epc open5gs-upfd[78244]: 0020: 00000000 00000016 3a000502 00000100   ........:.......
Oct  7 15:41:31 epc open5gs-upfd[78244]: 0030: 8f00e32f 00000001 04000000 ff020000   .../............
Oct  7 15:41:31 epc open5gs-upfd[78244]: 0040: 00000000 00000001 ff000000            ............
Oct  7 15:41:31 epc open5gs-upfd[78244]: #033[32m10/07 15:41:31.945#033[0m: [#033[33mupf#033[0m] #033[1;33mERROR#033[0m: Invalid packet [IP version:6, Packet Length:116] (../src/upf/gtp-path.c:533)
Oct  7 15:41:31 epc open5gs-upfd[78244]: 0000: 60000000 004c0001 fe800000 00000000   `....L..........
Oct  7 15:41:31 epc open5gs-upfd[78244]: 0010: 4abf74ff fe09d010 ff020000 00000000   J.t.............
Oct  7 15:41:31 epc open5gs-upfd[78244]: 0020: 00000000 00000016 3a000502 00000100   ........:.......
Oct  7 15:41:31 epc open5gs-upfd[78244]: 0030: 8f000de2 00000003 04000000 ff020000   ................
Oct  7 15:41:31 epc open5gs-upfd[78244]: 0040: 00000000 00000001 ff000000 04000000   ................
Oct  7 15:41:31 epc open5gs-upfd[78244]: 0050: ff020000 00000000 00000001 ff09d010   ................
Oct  7 15:41:31 epc open5gs-upfd[78244]: 0060: 04000000 ff020000 00000000 00000000   ................
Oct  7 15:41:31 epc open5gs-upfd[78244]: 0070: 00000002                              ....
```
It eventually locks up all traffic on the Open5gs server until I stop and restart the Open5GS processes.

I don't see any processes segfaulting or anything, just no traffic passes through the server any longer when it happens.

Seems to be happening every 2 days or so on a system with 180 eNB-UEs.
